title: Yoga Phone: Mindful Launcher
shortDescription: A calm, minimal home screen that helps you use your phone on purpose.
fullDescription:
A calmer phone, without giving up a useful one.

Yoga Phone replaces a busy home screen with a quiet, text-first launcher, and gives you gentle tools to use your phone on purpose. Awareness first. Friction only where you ask for it.

A CALM HOME SCREEN
• Your essential apps as clean type, under a large clock and the date
• Fast search: swipe up for every app
• A quiet dock: four apps you use most, around a search pill, in monochrome
• Three looks (Obsidian and Brass, Stone and Saffron, Midnight Sage) in light, dark or greyscale
• Profiles for work, reading or bedtime, each with its own home

KNOW WHERE YOUR TIME GOES
• A daily allowance for the apps that pull hardest, with a thin progress line on home
• Neutral reminders when you are close to your limit, or past it
• A usage dashboard and weekly insights: late nights, longest breaks, unlocks
• Optional "value of time": the illustrative value of time past your limit, at a rate you set. Never treated as money spent.

USE YOUR PHONE ON PURPOSE
• Mindful pause: a few seconds and an optional "What for?" before the apps you choose
• Timebox: give a session a boundary and get a gentle note when it ends
• Focus sessions and schedules that tuck distracting apps away and turn on Do Not Disturb
• Greyscale on your terms: over the limit, during focus or at bedtime
• Quiet notifications: hold chosen apps' notifications and read them later in a digest
• Yoga guard: turn off YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels, or give each a daily allowance. Regular videos stay.

FREE, WITH A 14-DAY YOGA PRO TRIAL
Every Pro feature is free for your first 14 days, with no card needed. After that, the home screen, search, dock, one allowance, the mindful pause for up to three apps, and Shorts and Reels blocking stay free. Yoga Pro (monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime unlock) keeps all three looks, unlimited allowances, focus and timebox, insights, value of time, quiet notifications, profiles and widgets. Nothing you set up is deleted if Pro pauses.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your usage data stays on your phone. No Yoga account, no server, no ads, no tracking. Purchases are handled by Google Play. You choose each permission when you turn a feature on, and you can delete everything at any time.

Yoga measures app foreground time from Android's usage data; figures can differ from other screen-time tools. Apps opened from notifications or other apps skip the mindful pause.

Accessibility service: Yoga guard optionally uses Android's AccessibilityService API to identify the open app for the live time-value indicator, and to recognise Shorts and Reels screens in YouTube, Instagram and the browsers you enable, so it can go Back when a surface you chose to block opens. Screen content is processed on your phone only and is never stored or sent. Yoga guard is off until you enable it after an in-app explanation, and you can turn it off at any time.
